The current NPS configuration on this computer or the configuration being imported contains Network Access Protection (NAP) policies or settings. These settings must be removed before upgrading or importing the configuration to this version of Windows. A list of settings that need to be removed is provided below. For more information about upgrade requirements, see http://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=392908.

The following settings must be removed:
411: • Remove all NAP Capable Computers conditions
412: • Remove all HCAP User Groups conditions
418: • Choose a different network access server
419: • Set NAP Enforcement to Allow full network access
422: • Uncheck 'Perform machine health check only' setting
